name: delta-and-fallback
body: The delta is `git diff --name-status -M <recorded>` for committed changes, PLUS working-tree/index/untracked state (`git status --porcelain`). Fall back to a full scan when the recorded commit is not an ancestor of HEAD, or when the binary/format/config cache key has drifted. These fallbacks are correctness/version gates, not heuristics. AC: each fallback condition has a test showing a correct full-scan result.
